seo.title: Menu
seo.description: The River Oaks lunch, dinner and drinks menus at Izakaya WA in Houston — small plates, sushi and sashimi, robata skewers, rice and noodles, and a considered sake list.

hero.title: The menu
hero.intro: An izakaya menu is meant to be shared. Order a few plates, pass them around, and add more as the evening goes on.
